home.title: Choose your analysis mode
home.desc: Choose the tool that best matches your need. Our multi-model RAG AI Agent helps you work with your documents.
home.chat_desc:
Ask your own questions about your documents.
Upload your reports and chat freely with the AI. It will cite every answer directly from the provided content.
home.diagnostic_desc:
Automatic structured analysis.
The RAG pipeline intelligently extracts key indicators (revenue, HR, data, cyber) and generates a pre-formatted JSON for the Copilot.
home.multi_desc:
Cross-analysis of multiple documents.
Upload several reports at once (e.g. competitors, different years) and generate a targeted comparative summary.
